note: Evaluation lines written for this test, no book involved: an invented cast on an old salvage tug in orbit (a rough-spoken scrap hunter, a small repair robot and its self-styled sister, a theatrical stowaway, a calm captain). Each line carries the facts a reader would record and the checks a correct translation passes.

entries.note: the repair robot's name and its beep
the cargo robot's name and beep
the rival salvage crew Kiwa cannot stand; keep as a name
an old-fashioned cheer written in kanji; keep it as a word, in capitals

characters.name: 穂刈季和
characters.style: rough, blunt dockside speech; short bursts; swears
characters.role: the heroine, a salvager deep in debt who keeps an old tug flying

characters.name: ヒョ
characters.style: chirpy, eager fragments; its beep is "Hyo"

characters.name: 楠戸朔
characters.role: a stowaway who calls himself a poet of the stars

characters.name: 岩鼻船長
characters.role: the tug's owner, trusted by the crew

characters.name: ヒャ
characters.style: playful, teasing, affectionate; ends sentences with "hya"
characters.role: a cargo robot that calls itself Hyo's big sister

style.tone: rough comedy: a foul-mouthed salvager and two cheerful, oblivious robots; keep the contrast
rules: Keep Japanese name order (family name first): Hokari Kiwa, Kusudo Saku.
The repair robot's beep is always "Hyo" ("Hyo!", "Hyo hyo"); the cargo robot's is "Hya".
Kiwa talks rough: contractions, slang, blunt; never make her polite.
Sound effects become short onomatopoeia in capitals.
Do not invent names for unnamed bystanders; use a pronoun or a role.

items.ja: うるせぇぞ、ヒョ。寝起きに警報鳴らすんじゃねえ。
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: ヒョ！季和、回収屋の出番ヒョ！デブリが来てるヒョ！
items.speaker: ヒョ

items.ja: ……まだ寝る。
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: 天晴！我こそは楠戸朔、星を渡る詩人なり！
items.speaker: 楠戸朔

items.ja: 穂刈季和、十九歳。借金を返すため、今日も宇宙のゴミを拾う。
ヒャはヒョのお姉さんヒャ！荷物はまかせるヒャ！
items.speaker: ヒャ

items.ja: てめえが盗んだパーツは
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: 全部返してもらうぞ
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: 皆さん、慌てないでください。船の修理は私が責任を持って手配します。
items.speaker: 岩鼻船長

items.ja: 発進ヒョ！
items.speaker: ヒョ

items.ja: 季和が戻ってきた。機嫌が悪いみたいだ。
items.speaker: ヒョ

items.ja: 楠戸が来た。また長い詩を聞かされるぞ。
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: 楠戸さん、助かりました。
items.speaker: 岩鼻船長

items.ja: このエンジン、また止まってやがる。
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: 穂刈さん、後で船長室へ。
items.speaker: 岩鼻船長

items.ja: 回収屋ってのは
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: 楽な商売じゃねえんだよ
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: ヒョ、ヒョ、ヒョ～！
items.speaker: ヒョ

items.ja: ガシャーン
茶ぁ……誰か淹れろ。
items.speaker: 穂刈季和

items.ja: その年、港で一番口の悪い女が回収屋の免許を取った。
季和ちゃんは働き者ヒャ。
items.speaker: ヒャ

items.ja: 船長！お呼びでしょうか！
items.speaker: 楠戸朔

items.ja: ……ナンデモネ。
items.speaker: 穂刈季和
